id.description: Unique identifier for the tunnel, prefixed with `tnl_`.

domain.description: Anthropic-assigned hostname for the tunnel. MCP server URLs whose host is a subdomain of this value are routed through the tunnel. Globally unique and never reused, even after the tunnel is archived.

display_name.description: Human-readable name for the tunnel (1-255 characters). Null if unset.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the tunnel was created.

archived_at.description: RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the tunnel was archived. Null if it is not archived.
